a: Al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye valah. rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: al happogemet ketubbatah.

Azal rav mardochay, amra lishmata kammeh derav ashe: bishlama leman deamar al happogemet ketubbatah — demasseka addata: dilma mitztarchi li zuze veshakelna mikketubbetay, veamra leh: ketov li dela mashbeat li. ella leman deamar al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye valah, ihi mi havat yada demotev la appotroppeya, deamra leh: "ketov li dela mashbeat li"?

Amar leh: attun, aha matnitu la, anan aha matnenan la: halcha mikkever balah levet aviha, o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya — en hayyorshin mashbiin otah. veim naaset appotroppeya — yorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo, veen mashbiin otah al sheavar.
Sheavar may avidteh? amar rav yehuda amar rav: al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye habbaal,
Aval ben mita likvura mashbeinan la. verav matna amar: afillu ben mita likvura la mashbeinan la, deamri nehardae: lichraga velimzone velikvura — mezabbeninan bela achrazta.

Amar rabba amar rabbi chiyyay: "dela neder udela shevua" — hu eno yachol lehashebiah, aval yorshin mashbiin otah. "neki neder neki shevua" — ben hu uven yorshin en mashbiin otah. hachi kaamar la: menakkeyat mishshevuata.

Verav yosef amar rabbi chiyyay: "dela neder udela shevua" — hu eno yachol lehashebiah, aval yorshin mashbiin otah. "neki neder neki shevua" — ben hu uven yorshin mashbiin otah. hachi kaamar la: nakkay nafshich bishvuata.

Shelach rabbi zakkay lemar ukeva: ben "dela shevua", ben "dinki shevua", ben "dela neder" uven "dinki neder" — "benichsay" hu eno yachol lehashebiah, aval yorshin mashbiin otah. minnichsayya illen — ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah.

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshum abba shaul ben imma miryam: ben "dela shevua", ben "dinki shevua", ben "dela neder", uven "dinki neder", ben "minnichsay", uven "minnichsayya illen" — ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah. aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim: habba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua.

Veikka deamri la, matnita abba shaul ben imma miryam amar: ben "dela shevua", ben "dinki shevua", ben "dela neder", uven "neki neder", ben "minnichse", uven "minnichsayya illen" — ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah, aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim: habba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua. amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha keven imma miryam.
Mishna happogemet ketubbatah — lo tippara ella bishvua. ed echad meidah shehi perua — lo tippara ella bishvua. minnichse yetomim, uminnechasim meshuebadim, veshello befanav — lo tippara ella bishvua.
Happogemet ketubbatah ketzad? hayta ketubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah: hitkabbalt ketubbatich, vehi omeret: lo hitkabbalti ella mane — lo tippara ella bishvua.
Ed echad meidah shehi perua, ketzad? hayta ketubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah: hitkabbalt ketubbatich, vehi omeret: lo hitkabbalti, veed echad meidah shehi perua — lo tippara ella bishvua.
Minnechasim meshuebadim ketzad? machar nechasav laacherim vehi nifraat min hallakochot — lo tippara ella bishvua.
Minnichse yetomim ketzad? met vehinniach nechasav litomim, vehi nifraat min hayyetomim — lo tippara ella bishvua.
Veshello befanav ketzad? halach lo limdinat hayyam, vehi nifraat shello befanav — enah nifraat ella bishvua.
b: Rabbi shimon omer: kol zeman shehi tovaat ketubbatah — hayyorshin mashbiin otah, veim enah tovaat ketubbatah — en hayyorshin mashbiin otah.
Gemara savar rame bar chama lememar shevua deorayyta — deka taen matayim veka mode leh bemea, havya leh hodaa bemiktzat hattaana, vechol hammode bemiktzat hattaana — yishshava.
Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar: chada — dechol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin, vehi nishbaat venotelet. veod: en nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot.
Ella amar rava: midderabbanan, defara — dayek, demippera — la dayek, uremo rabbanan shevua ala ki hechi detiddok.
Ibbaya lehu: pogemet ketubbatah beedim, mahu? im ita defara — beedim hava para la, o dilma itremoye itremi leh?

Ta shema: kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin. veellu nishbain venotlin: hassachir, vehannigzal, vehannechbal, veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, vechenvani al pinkaso, vehappogem shetaro shello beedim. shello beedim — in, beedim — la!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya beedim — devadday tzericha shevua, aval shello beedim, ema tehve kemeshiv aveda vetishkol belo shevua, ka mashma lan.
Ibbaya lehu: happogemet ketubbatah pachot pachot mishshave peruta, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deka dayyka kulle hay, kusheta ka amra, o dilma iarome ka miarma? teku.
Ibbaya lehu: pochetet ketubbatah, mahu? mi amrinan hayeynu pogemet, o dilma: pogemet modya bemiktzat, ha la ka modya bemiktzat.
Ta shema: pochetet — tippara shello bishvua. ketzad? hayta ketubbatah elef zuz, veamar lah "hitkabbalt ketubbatich", vehi omeret "lo hitkabbalti, veenah ella mane" — nifraat shello bishvua.
Bemay gavya? behay shetara? hay shetara chaspa bealma hu! amar rava bereh derabba: beomeret "amana hayta li beni leveno".

Ed echad meidah shehi perua. sevar rame bar chama lememar shevua deorayyta, dichtiv: "lo yakum ed echad beish lechol avon ulechol chattat". lechol avon ulechol chattat hu deeno kam, aval kam hu lishvua. veamar mar: kol makom shehashshenayim mechayyeyvin oto mamon — echad mechayyeyvo shevua.
Amar rava, shete teshuvot baddavar. chada: dechol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin, vehi nishbaat venotelet. veod: en nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot.
Ella amar rava: midderabbanan, kede lehafis dato shel baal.
Amar rav pappa:

a: I pikkeach hu, mayyte la lide shevua deorayyta. yahev la ketubbeta beappe chad sahada, vesamech sahada kamma assahada batra, umokem lehu lehanach kammae bemilva.

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: heach samech sahada kamma assahada batra? ella amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: yahev la ketubbeta beappe sahada kamma vesahada batra umokem le[u] lehanach kammae behalevaa.
Matkef la rav ashe, akkatti yechola lememar: shete ketubbot havay! ella amar rav ashe: hu demoda lehu.
Minnechasim meshuebadim. tenan hatam: vechen hayyetomim lo yipparu ella bishvua.
Mimman? ilema millove — hasheta avihen shakel bela shevua, veinhu bishvua?! ella hachi kaamar: vechen hayyetomim min hayyetomim — lo yipparu ella bishvua.
Amar rav zerika amar rav yehuda, lo shanu ella sheamru yetomim: amar lanu abba "laviti ufarati", aval amru: amar lanu abba "lo laviti" — af bishvua lo yipparu.
Matkef la rava, adderabba: kol haomer "lo laviti" — keomer "lo parati" dame,

Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar, amar rav zerika amar rav yehuda: lo shanu ella sheamru yetomim: amar lanu abba "laviti ufarati", aval amru: amar lanu abba "lo laviti" — nifrain shello bishvua. shekkol haomer "lo laviti" keomer "lo parati" dame.
Venifraat shello befanav, lo tippara ella bishvua. amar rav acha sar habbira: maase ba lifne rabbi yitzchak beantochya, veamar: lo shanu ella lichtubbat ishsha, mishshum chinna. aval baal chov — la.
Verava amar rav nachman: afillu baal chov, shello yehe kol echad veechad notel meotav shel chavero, veholech veyoshev bimdinat hayyam, veatta noel delet bifne lovin.

Rabbi shimon omer: kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah vechulei. rabbi shimon aheyay? amar rabbi yirmeya, aha: venifraat shello befanav, la tippara ella bishvua. la shena limzone vela shena lichtubba. vaata rabbi shimon lememar: kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah — yorsheha mashbiin otah.
b: Enah tovaat ketubbatah — en yorshin mashbiin otah. vekamippalgi biflugeta dechanan uvene kohanim gedolim. ditnan: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, chanan omer: tishshava bassof, velo tishshava battechilla.
Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru: tishshava battechilla uvassof. rabbi shimon kechanan, rabbanan kivne kohanim gedolim.
Matkef la rav sheshet: hay yorshin mashbiin otah? bet din mashbiin otah mibbee leh!

Ella amar rav sheshet, aha: halcha mikkever balah levet aviha, o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya — en hayyorshim mashbiin otah. veim naaset appotroppeya — yorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo, veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar. vaata rabbi shimon lememar: kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah — yorshin mashbiin otah, enah tovaat ketubbatah — en hayyorshin mashbiin otah.

Vekamippalgi biflugeta deabba shaul verabbanan. ditnan: appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim — yishshava. minnuhu bet din — lo yishshava. abba shaul omer, chilluf haddevarim: minnuhu bet din — yishshava, minnahu avi yetomim — lo yishshava.
Rabbi shimon keabba shaul, verabbanan kerabbanan.
Matkef la abbaye: hay "kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah" — im tovaat mibbee leh!

Ella amar abbaye, aha: katav lah "neder ushevua en li alayich" — eno yachol lehashebiah kulei. "neder ushevua en li, velo leyorshay, velo labbaim birshuti, alayich, veal yorshayich, veal habbain birshutich" — en yachol lehashebiah lo hu, velo yorshav, velo habbain birshuto. lo hi, velo yorsheha, velo habbain birshutah. vaata rabbi shimon lememar: kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah — yorshin mashbiin otah.
Vekamippalgi biflugeta deabba shaul ben imma miryam verabbanan. rabbi shimon keabba shaul, verabbanan kerabbanan.
Matkef la rav pappa: hatinach kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah. enah tovaat ketubbatah, may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rav pappa: leappoke midderabbi eliezer umachluketo.
Mishna hotzia get veen immo ketubba —

a: Gova ketubbatah.
Ketubba veen immah get, hi omeret: avad gitti. vehu omer: avad shovari. vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo perozbul — hare ellu lo yipparu.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: min hassakkana veelach — ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget, uvaal chov gove shello bifrozbul.
Gemara shema minna kotvin shovar. dei en kotvin shovar, lechush dilma mappeka la lichtubbeta, vegavya ba.
Amar rav: bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan. ushemuel amar: af bemakom shekkotvin ketubba.

Velishmuel kotvin shovar? amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel: bimkom sheen kotvin veamar "katavti" — alav lehavi reaya. bimkom shekkotvin veamra "lo katav li" — aleha lehavi reaya.
Veaf rav hadar beh, deamar rav: ben bimkom shekkotvin, ben bimkom sheen kotvin, get — gova ikkar. ketubba — gova tosefet. vechol harotze lehashiv — yavo veyashiv.
Tenan: ketubba veen immah get, hi omeret "avad gitti", vehu omer "avad shovari". vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo perozbul — hare ellu lo yipparu.
Bishlama lishmuel — moke la bimkom sheen kotvin veamar katavti, deamrinan leh: ayyti reaya, vei la mayyte reaya, amrinan leh: zil pareh.
Ella lerav: nehi deikkar la gavya, tosefet miha tigbe.
Amar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan — kesheen sham ede gerushin. miggo deyachol lememar: lo gerashtiha,
b: Yachol lememar: gerashtiha venatatti lah ketubbatah.

Ha middekatane sefa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: min hassakkana veelach ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget, uvaal chov shello bifrozbul. bidikka ede gerushin askinan. dei lekka ede gerushin, bemay gavya?

Ella kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: hare ellu lo yipparu. bamme devarim amurim: kesheen sham ede gerushin, aval yesh sham ede gerushin — gavya tosefet. veikkar, i mappeka gitta — gavya, vei la mappeka gitta — la gavya.
Umin hassakkana veelach, af al gav dela mappeka gitta — gavya. sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer: missakkana veelach ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget, uvaal chov shello bifrozbul.
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: ledidach deamrat get gova ikkar, almana min hannissuin bemay gavya? beede mita. velechush dilma gershah, umappeka legitta vegavya beh?! beyoshevet tachat balah.
Vedilma samuch lemita gershah! ihu hu deafsed annafsheh.
Almana min haerusin bemay gavya — beede mita, velechush dilma gershah, umappeka gitta vegavya!

Ella: bimkom dela efshar katvinan shovar. dei la tema hachi, ede mita gufayyhu nechush dilma mappeka ede mita behay be dina vegavya, vahadar mappeka beve dina acharina vegavya. ella vadday bimkom dela efshar katvinan shovar.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: almana min haerusin, menalan deit la ketubba? illema meha: nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin, gova et hakkol — dilma dichtav la.
Vechi tema: i ketav la, may lememra! leappoke midderabbi elazar ben azarya, deamar: shello katav lah ella al menat shehu konsah.
Dayka name, dekatane: gova et hakkol. i amrat bishlama dechatav lah — mishshum hachi gova et hakkol. ella i amrat dela ketav la. may "gova et hakkol"? mane matayim hu deit lah!
Veella, middetane rav chiyyay bar avin: ishto arusa, lo onen velo mittamme lah. vechen hi, lo onenet velo mittammea lo. meta — eno yorshah, met hu — gova ketubbatah.
Dilma dichtav la. vechi tema: i ketav la may lememra? meta eno yorshah itztericha leh.

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: lerav deamar get gova ikkar, lechush dilma mappeka gitta behay be dina vegavya, vehadra mappeka beve dina acharina vegavya? vechi tema dekarinan leh! amra: baena leinnesove beh.
Dekarinan leh vechatvinan aggabbeh: gitta denan keranohi lav mishshum degitta pasul hu, ella dela tihdar vetigbe beh zimna acharina.
Mishna shene gittin ushete chetubbot, gova shete chetubbot.
Shete chetubbot veget echad, o ketubba ushene gittin, o ketubba veget umita — enah gova ella ketubba achat. shehamegaresh et ishto vehechzirah — al menat ketubba harishona machzirah.
Gemara i baaya behay — gavya, i baaya behay — gavya?
Lema tehve teyuveta derav nachman amar shemuel. deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: shene shetarot hayyotzin baze achar ze, bittel sheni et harishon.
Lav ittemar ala, amar rav pappa: umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla, letosefet katveh. hacha name bidosef la.
Tanu rabbanan: hotzia get uchetubba umita,

a: Im get kodem lakketubba — gova shete ketubbot. ketubba kodemet lagget — enah gova ella ketubba achat, shehammegaresh et ishto vehechzirah — al menat ketubba harishona hechzirah.
Mishna katan shehissio aviv — ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyeymah. ger shennitgayyeyra ishto immo — ketubbatah kayyemet, sheal menat ken kiyyeymah.
Gemara amar rav huna: lo shanu ella mane matayim, aval tosefet — en lah. verav yehuda amar: afillu tosefet yesh lah.
Metivi: chiddeshu — notelet ma shechiddeshu. chiddeshu in, lo chiddeshu la!
Ema: af ma shechiddeshu. veha la tane hachi: chiddeshu — notelet ma shechiddeshu, lo chiddeshu — betula gova matayim, vealmana mane! teyuveta derav yehuda.
Rav yehuda matnitin ateteh, hu savar: "ketubbatah kayyemet" — akkulla milleta kae. vela hi, aikkar ketubba kae.
Hadaran alach hakkotev leishto
Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim, vamet — harishona kodemet lashsheniyya. veyorshe harishona kodmin leyorshe sheniyya.
Nasa et harishona vameta, nasa sheniyya umet hu — sheniyya veyorsheha kodmin leyorshe harishona.
Gemara middekatane "harishona kodemet lashsheniyya", vela katane "harishona yesh lah vehashsheniyya en lah", mikkelal dei kadma sheniyya vetafsa — la mappekinan minna,
Shema minna: baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava — ma sheggava gava.
Leolam ema lach: ma sheggava — lo gava, umay "kodemet" — ligmare katane, keditnan: ben kodem labbat.
Ikka deamri: middela katane "im kadma sheniyya vetafsa en motziin miyyadah", mikkelal dei kadma sheniyya vetafsa — mappekinan minna.
Shema minna: baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava — ma sheggava lo gava.
Leolam ema lach ma sheggava — gava, ayyeyde ditna: sheniyya veyorsheha kodmin leyorshe harishona,
b: Tena name: harishona kodemet lashsheniyya.
Nasa et harishona. shema minna telat: shema minna achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, vela chayyshinan leinnetzoye.
Mimmay — middekatane: sheniyya veyorsheha kodmim leyorshe rishona, mikdam hu dekadmi, ha ikka — shakli.
Ushema minna: ketubba naaset motar lachavertah.
Mimmay? middela katane "im yesh sham motar dinar".
Ushema minna: ketubbat benin dichrin la tarfa mimmeshabedi, dei salka datin tarfa mimmeshabedi — leto bene rishona velitrefinhu livne sheniyya.
Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach achat bechayyav veachat bemoto en lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, umay "kodmin" — lenachala katane.
Vechi tema: "yorshe harishona" lema li? ayyeyde ditna "sheniyya veyorsheha", tena name "leyorshe harishona".
Udekaamrat: ketubba naaset motar lachavertah — dilma leolam ema lach: en ketubba naaset motar lachavertah, vehacha hu deikka motar dinar.

"Veachat bechayyav veachat bemoto" — tannae hi, detanya: metu achat bechayyav veachat bemoto, ben nannas omer: yecholin bene harishona lomar livne hashsheniyya: bene baalat chov attem, telu ketubbat immechem utzeu.
Rabbi akiva omer: kevar kaftza nachala millifne bene harishona venafla lifne bene hashsheniyya.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, umar savar: achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — en lahen ketubbat benin dichrin.

Amar rabba, ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri: dechulle alma achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, vehacha bichtubba naaset motar lachavertah vehu haddin levaal chov kamippalgi.
Mar savar: ketubba naaset motar lachavertah, vehu haddin levaal chov, umar savar: en ketubba naaset motar lachavertah, vehu haddin levaal chov,
Veamena lehu ana: bevaal chov kulle alma la peligi dehave motar, ki peligi bichtubba.
Matkef la rav yosef: i hachi, "rabbi akiva omer: kevar kaftza nachala" — "im yesh motar dinar" mibbee leh!
Ella amar rav yosef: beachat bechayyav veachat bemoto ka mippalgi.

Vehane tannae ki hane tannae, detanya: nasa et harishona vameta, nasa et hashsheniyya umet hu — bain baneha shel zo leachar mita venotlin ketubbat imman. rabbi shimon omer: im yesh motar dinar — ellu notlin ketubbat imman, veellu notlin ketubbat imman. veim lav — cholkin beshave.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, umar savar: achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — en lahem ketubbat benin dichrin.
La, dechulle alma achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin,

a: Vehacha bedinar mekarkee kamippalgi. mar savar: mekarkee — in, mittaltele — la. umar savar: afillu mittalteli.
Umi matzet amrat hachi? vehatnan, rabbi shimon omer: afillu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem achrayut — enan kelum, ad sheyyehe sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut yater al shete ketubbot dinar!
Ella, hacha bedinar meshabedi kamippalgi. mar savar: mibbene chorin — in, mimmeshabedi — la, umar savar: afillu mimmeshabedi.
I hachi, rabbi shimon omer: "im yesh sham motar dinar" — "kevan sheyyesh sham motar dinar" mibbee leh!
Ella: befachot middinar kamippalgi, mar savar: dinar — in, pachot middinar — la, umar savar: afillu pachot middinar.
Veha rabbi shimon "dinar" kaamar! vechi tema: efoch, tanna kamma dematnitin name dinar kaamar!
Ella ki hanach tere lishshaney kammae veefoch.
Amar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa, hilcheta: achat bechayyav veachat bemoto — yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, uchetubba naaset motar lachavertah.
Bishlama i ashmeinan achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin, vela ashmeinan ketubba naaset motar lachavertah, hava amena: i ikka motar dinar — in, i la — la.
Ella layshmeinan ketubba naaset motar lachavertah, vaana yadana mishshum deachat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin!
I ashmeinan hachi, hava amena: kegon shennasa shalosh nashim, vametu shetayim bechayyav veachat bemoto. vehach demayet leachar mita — yoledet nekeva hi, velav bat yerushsha hi.
Aval achat bechayyav veachat bemoto, veha dilachar mita yoledet zachar hi — ema lechush leinnetzoye, ka mashma lan.
Mishna mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim, vametu, veachar kach met hu, vitomim mevakkeshin ketubbat imman veen sham ella shete chetubbot — cholkin beshave.
Haya sham motar dinar — ellu notlim ketubbat imman veellu notlim ketubbat imman.
Im amru yetomim: anachnu maalim al nichse avinu yafe dinar kede sheyyittelu ketubbat imman — en shomin lahen, ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din.
Hayu sham nechasim berauy — enan kivmuchezak.
Rabbi shimon omer: afillu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem achrayut, enan kelum, ad sheyyihyu sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut yoter al shete hakketubbot dinar.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: lazo elef velazo chamesh meot, im yesh sham motar dinar — ellu notlin ketubbat imman veellu notlin ketubbat imman. veim lav — yachleku beshave.
Peshita: merubbin venitmaatu — kevar zachu bahen yorshin. muatin venitrabbu may?
Ta shema: denichse deve bar tzartzur muatin venitrabbu havo, vaato lekammeh derav amram. amar lehu: zilu payyeysinhu. la ashgachu.
Amar lehu: i la mefayyeysitu lehu, machena lechu besilva dela mabba dema. shadderinhu lekammeh derav nachman, amar lahen: keshem shemmerubbin venitmaatu
b: Zachu bahen yorshin — kach muatin venitrabbu zachu bahen yorshin.
(Siman: elef umea mitzva bichtubba yaakov zakaf sedotav bidvarim asikin).
Hahu gavra dahavo masseki beh alpa zuze, havo leh tere appadne, zabbeninhu chada bachamesh mea vachada bachamesh mea. ata baal chov tarfa lachada minnayyhu, hadar kataref leiddach.
Shekal alpa zuze veka azel legabbeh, amar leh: i shavya lach alpa zuze — lechayye, vei la — shekoyl alpa zuze veistallak.
Sevar rame bar chama lememar: hayeynu matnitin im amru yetomim "hare anu maalin al nichse avinu yafe dinar".
Amar leh rava: mi dame? hatam — it lehu peseda leyatme, hacha — mi it leh peseda? alpa yahev vealpa shakel!
Vetirfa, bechamma katvinan?
Ravina amar: bealpa. rav avvira amar: bachamesh mea. vehilcheta: bachamesh mea.

Hahu gavra dahavo masseki beh mea zuze. havo leh tere kattine deara, (chad zabbenhu) [zabbeninhu lechad] bechamshin vechad bechamshin. ata baal chov tarfa lechad minnayyhu, hadar ata vekataref leiddach.
Shekal mea zuze vekaazel legabbeh vaamar leh: i shavya lach mea zuze — lechayye, vei la — shekol mea zuze veistallak.
Savar rav yosef lememar: hayeynu matnitin im amru yetomim kulei. amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam — it lehu peseda leyatme, hacha — may peseda it leh? mea yahev, mea shakel.
Vetirpa bechamma katvinan? ravina amar: bima, rav avvira amar: bechamshin. vehilcheta bechamshin.
Hahu gavra dahavo masseki beh mea zuze. shachev, shevak kattina deara dahava shavya chamshin zuze. ata baal chov vekataref leh, azul yatme yehavu leh chamshin zuze, hadar kataref la.
Ato lekammeh deabbaye. amar lahen: mitzva al hayyetomim lifroa chov avihen. hane kammae mitzva avditu, hasheta ki taref — bedin kataref.
Vela amaran dela amaru leh: "hane chamshin zuze deme deara kattina", aval amaru leh: "hane chamshin zuze deme ara kattina" — salloke salleku.
Hahu gavra dezabbena lichtubbeta deimmeh betovat hanaa, vaamar leh: i atya em umearara, la mefatztzena lach.
Shechiva immeh vela (i)arara, vaata ihu veka mearar. sevar rame bar chama lememar: ihu bimkom immeh kae. amar leh rava: nehi deachrayut dida la kabbel aleh, achrayut dideh mi la kabbel?
Amar rame bar chama: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachrayut, vaata shimon umecharah liruven beachrayut,

a: Vaata baal chov diruven vekataref leh minneh — dina hu deazel shimon umefatztze leh.
Amar leh rava: nehi deachrayut dealma kabbel aleh, achrayut denafsheh mi kabbel aleh?

Umode rava biruven sheyyarash sade miyyaakov, umecharah leshimon shello beachrayut, vaata shimon umecharah liruven beachrayut, vaata baal chov deyaakov, vekataref leh minneh — dina hu deazel shimon umefatztze leh minneh.
May tama? baal chov deyaakov kevaal chov dealma dame.
Amar rame bar chama: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachrayut, vezakaf alav bemilva, umet reuven, vaata baal chov diruven vekataref la mishshimon ufayyeyseh bezuze —
Dina hu deamri leh bene reuven: anan mittalteli shevak avun gabbach, umittalteli deyatme levaal chov la mishtabedi.

Amar rava: i pikkeach iddach, magbe lehu nihalayyhu ara vahadar gave la minnayyhu, kerav nachman. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihen — baal chov chozer vegove otah mehen.
Amar rabba: reuven shemmachar kol sedotav leshimon, vechazar shimon umachar sade achat lelevi, vaata baal chov diruven — ratza mizze gove, ratza mizze gove.
Vela amaran ella dezabbene benonit, aval zabbene iddit vezibburit, matze amar leh: lehachi terachi uzevayni ara dela chazya lach.
Uvenonit name la amaran, ella dela shevak benonit dichvota,
b: Aval shevak benonit dichvota, matze amar leh: hinnachti lach makom ligbot hemennu.

Amar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachrayut, vaata baal chov diruven vekataref la minneh, dina hu deazel reuven umefatztze leh. vela matze amar leh: lav baal devarim didi at. mishshum deamar leh: demappekat minneh, alay hadar.
Veikka deamri: afillu shello beachrayut name, deamar leh: la nicha li detehve leh leshimon taromet alay.
Amar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachrayut, veyatzu alav

a: Asikin, ad shello hechzik bah — yachol lachazor bo, mishshehechzik bah — eno yachol lachazor bo. mishshum deamar leh: chayyta dekitre sevart vekabbelt. umeemat machzek ba? mikki dayesh ammitzre.
Ikka deamri afillu beachrayut name. deamar leh: achvi tirfach vaashallem lach.
Mishna mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim, vamet, ketubbatah shel zo mane, veshel zo matayim, veshel zo shelosh meot, veen sham ella mane — cholkin beshave.

Hayu sham matayim, shel mane notelet chamishshim, shel matayim veshel shelosh meot shelosha shelosha shel zahav. hayu sham shelosh meot — shel mane notelet chamishshim, veshel matayim mane, veshel shelosh meot shishsha shel zahav.
Vechen shelosha shehittilu lakkis, pichatu o hotiru — kach hen cholkin.
Gemara shel mane notelet chamishshim? telatin utelata vetilta hu deit la!
Amar shemuel: bechotevet baalat matayim levaalat mane "din udevarim en li immach bemane".
I hachi, ema sefa: shel matayim veshel shelosh meot shalosh shalosh shel zahav. tema la: ha sallekt nafshich minna!
Mishshum deamra la: middin udevarim hu desalliki nafshay.
Hayu sham shelosh meot vechulei.
Shel matayim mane? shivim vachamishsha hu deit la!
Amar shemuel: bechotevet baalat shelosh meot levaalat matayim ulevaalat mane "din udevarim en li immachem bemane".
Rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina amar: resha bishte tefisot, vesefa bishte tefisot.
Resha bishte tefisot — denaflu shivin vachamishsha bechad zimna, umea veesrim vachamishsha bechad zimna.
Sefa bishte tefisot — denaflu shivim vachamishsha bechad zimna, umatayim veesrim vachamishsha bechad zimna.
Tanya: zo mishnat rabbi natan. rabbi omer: en ani roe devarav shel rabbi natan beellu, ella cholkot beshave.
Vechen shelosha shehetilu. amar shemuel: shenayim shehittilu lechis, ze mane veze matayim —
b: Hassachar laemtza.

Amar rabba: mistabbera milleteh dishmuel beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha, aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha — ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav. verav hamenuna amar: afillu shor lacharisha veomed litvicha — hassachar laemtza.
Metivi: shenayim shehittilu lakkis, ze mane veze matayim — hassachar laemtza. may lav, beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha, uteyuveta derabba? la, beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha.
Aval shor lacharisha veomed litvicha may — ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav. addetane sefa: lakach ze beshello veze beshello venitarvu — ze notel lefi meotav, veze notel lefi meotav,
Liflog velitne bedideh: bamme devarim amurim, beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha. aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha — ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav!

Hachi name kaamar: bamme devarim amurim, beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha. aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha — naase kemi shellakach ze beshello veze beshello venitarvu, ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav.
Tenan: vechen shelosha shehittilu lakkis, pichatu o hotiru — kach hen cholkin,
May lav: "pichatu" — pichatu mammash, "hotiru" — hotiru mammash!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: la, "hotiru" — zuze chadte, "pichatu" — istera detzonita.

Mishna mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim vamet — harishona kodemet lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit. verishona nishbaat lashsheniyya. usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit, veharviit nifraat shello bishvua. ben nannas omer: vechi mippene shehi acharona niskeret? af hi lo tippara ella bishvua.
Hayu yotzot kullan beyom echad — kol hakkodemet lachavertah afillu shaa achat zachta. vechach hayu kotvin birushalayim shaot. hayu kullan yotzot beshaa achat, veen sham ella mane — cholkot beshave.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? amar shemuel:

a: Kegon shennimtzet achat mehen sade sheenah shello. uvevaal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava kamippalgi.
Tanna kamma savar: ma sheggava lo gava.
Uven nannas savar: ma sheggava gava.
(Amar) rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: dechulle alma — ma sheggava lo gava. vehacha bechayyshinan shemma tachsif kamippalgi,
Mar savar: chayyshinan shemma tachsif. umar savar: la chayyshinan shemma tachsif.
Abbaye amar: deabbaye kashshisha ikka benayyhu. detane abbaye kashshisha: yetomim sheamru — gedolim. veen tzarich lomar ketannim.
Tanna kamma let leh deabbaye kashshisha. uven nannas it leh deabbaye kashshisha.
Amar rav huna: hane tere ache utere shuttafe deit lehu dina bahade chad, vaazal chad minnayyhu bahadeh ledina — la matze iddach lememar leh: at lav baal devarim didi at. ella shelichuteh avad.
Ikkela rav nachman lesura. shayyluhi: ki hay gavvna may?
Amar lehu, matnitin hi: harishona nishbaat lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit. veillu rishona lashshelishit la katane, may tama, lav mishshum dishlichuta avda?
Mi dame? hatam shevua leechad ushevua lemea, hacha amar: illu ana havay, taenna tefe.
Vela amaran ella dela iteh bemata, aval iteh bemata — ibbei leh lemete.
Ittemar: shene shetarot hayyotzim beyom echad, rav amar: cholkin, ushemuel amar: shuda dedayyayne.
Lema rav deamar kerabbi meir, deamar: ede chatima karti.
b: Ushemuel deamar kerabbi elazar, deamar: ede mesira karti.
La, dechulle alma kerabbi elazar, vehacha beha kamippalgi, rav savar: chalukka adifa. ushemuel savar: shuda dedayyayne adifa.

Umi matzet mokmat leh lerav kerabbi elazar? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: af bishtarot. mikkelal derav savar bishtarot la! ella: mechavvavrta rav kerabbi meir, ushemuel kerabbi elazar.
Metivi: shene shetarot hayyotzim beyom echad cholkin, teyuveta dishmuel. amar lach shemuel: ha manni — rabbi meir hi, vaana daamari kerabbi elazar.
I rabbi meir, ema sefa: katav leechad umasar leacher — ze shemmasar lo kana. vei rabbi meir, ammay kana? haamar ede chatima karti!
Tannae hi. detanya, vachachamim omrim: yachloku, vechan amru: ma sheyyirtze hashshalish, yaase.
Immeh derame bar chama ketavtinhu lenichsa lerami bar chama betzafra, leureta ketavtinhu lemar ukeva bar chama.

Ata rame bar chama lekammeh derav sheshet, okmeh benichse. ata mar ukeva lekammeh derav nachman, okmeh benichse. ata rav sheshet lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: may tama avad mar hachi? amar leh: umay tama avad mar hachi?
Amar leh: dikdem. amar leh: attu birushalayim yatvinan dechatvinan shaot? ella mar may tama avad hachi? amar leh: shuda dedayyayne.
Amar leh: ana name shuda dedayyayne, amar leh: chada, daana dayyayna umar lav dayyayna. veod, meikkara lav betorat hachi atet la.
Hanhu tere shetare daato lekammeh derav yosef. chad hava katuv bechamsha benisan, vechad hava katuv beh benisan setama. okmeh rav yosef lehahu dechamsha benisan binchasim.
Amar leh iddach: vaana afsed? amar leh: at yadcha al hattachtona, ema bar esrim vetisha benisan at.
Amar leh: venichtov li mar

a: Tirfa meiyyayr veelach. amar leh: yachli lememar lach: at bar chad benisan at.
May takkanteh? nichtevu hareshaa lahadade.

Mishna mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umachar et sadehu, vechatva rishona lallokeach "din udevarim en li immach" — hashsheniyya motzia mehallokeach, verishona min hashsheniyya, vehallokeach min harishona. vechozrot chalila, ad sheyyaasu peshara benehem. vechen baal chov, vechen ishsha baalat chov.

Gemara vechi katva leh may have? vehatanya: haomer lachavero "din udevarim en li al sade zo", veen li esek bah", veyaday mesullakot hemenna" — lo amar kelum. hacha bemay askinan — beshekkanu miyyadah.
Vechi kanu miyyadah may have? tema: nachat ruach asiti levali. mi la tenan: lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha — mikkacho batel. alma: yechola hi shettomar nachat ruach asiti levali.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha rabbi meir, ha rabbi yehuda.
Detanya: katav larishon velo chatma lo, lashsheni vechatma lo — ibbeda ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer, yechola hi shettomar: "nachat ruach asiti levali, attem ma lachem alay"?
Verabbi, satem la hacha kerabbi meir vesatem la hatam kerabbi yehuda?!
Amar rav pappa: bigrusha, vedivre hakkol.

Rav ashe amar: kulla rabbi meir hi, vead kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella bishne lakochot, deamri la: i ita denachat ruach avadt — lekamma ibbei lach lemibad. aval belokeach echad, afillu rabbi meir mode. umatnitin dichtav leh leacher.
Tenan hatam: en nifrain minnechasim meshuebadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin, vaafillu hen zibburit. ibbaya lehu: ishteduf bene chare, mahu delitrof mimmeshabedi?
Ta shema: katav larishon velo chatma lo, lashsheni vechatma lo — ibbeda ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir.
Vei salka datach ishteduf bene chare taref mimmeshabedi, nehi deibbeda ketubbatah mishsheni — merishon miha tigbe.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may "ibbeda" — ibbeda mishsheni.

Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada: deibbeda" ligmare mashma. veod, tanya: lava min haechad umachar nechasav lishnayim, vechatav baal chov lelokeach sheni: "din udevarim en li immach" — en lo al lokeach rishon kelum. mippene sheyyachol lomar: hinnachti lecha makom ligbot hemennu.
Hatam ihu deafsed nafsheh beyadayim.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe:
b: Veha maasim bechol yom, dehahu gavra demayshken leh pardesa lechavreh laasar shenin, vekash lachamesh shenin, vaata lekammayyhu derabbanan uchetavu leh tirfa!
Hatam name, inhu hu deafsidu annafshayyhu, kevan dahavo yadi defardesa aved dekish, la ibbei lehu lemizban.
Vehilcheta: ishteduf bene chare — tarfa mimmeshabedi.
Amar abbaye: "nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni", veamda venisset — baal lokeach have, veen leacharayich" bimkom baal kelum.

Keman — ki hay tanna, detanya: "nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni", yarad harishon umachar — hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon.
Umi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: ezehu rasha arum — ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel!
Mi kaamar tinnase? "nisset" kaamar.
Veamar abbaye: "nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni" umachra vameta — habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot, veacharayich" miyyad baal, velokeach miyyad "acharayich". umokminan lechullehu bida delokeach.
May shena meha ditnan: vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehen? hatam it lehu peseda lechullehu, hacha lokeach hu deit leh peseda.
Azal rafram amar lishmata kammeh derav ashe. mi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: "nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni", amda venisset — baal lokeach have, veen leacharayich" bimkom baal kelum.
Amar leh: hatam deamar la keshehi penuya, hacha deamar la keshehi nesua. may kaamar la — "acharayich" likne, baal la likne.
Vechen baal chov. tana: vechen baal chov ushene lakochot.
Vechen ishsha baalat chov ushene lakochot.
Hadaran alach mi shehaya nasuy
Almana nizzonet minnichse yetomim — maase yadeha shellahen, veen chayyayvin bikvuratah. yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah chayyayvin bikvuratah.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: "nizzonet" tenan o "hannizzonet" tenan? nizzonet tenan, ucheanshe galil, vela saggi dela yahavi la,
O dilma "hannizzonet" tenan, ucheanshe yehuda, vei bau la yahavi la.

a: Ta shema, amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: metziat almana leatzmah. i amrat bishlama "hannizzonet" tenan — shappir. ella i amrat "nizzonet" tenan, nihvo kevaal: ma baal metziat ishsha levalah, hacha name metziat ishsha layyorshim!
Leolam ema lach: "nizzonet" tenan: tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah — dela tehve la eva. hane — tehve lehu eva.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah, almana osa layyorshim, chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol melachot shehaeved ose lerabbo — talmid ose lerabbo, chutz mehattarat (lo) minal.

Amar rava: la amaran ella bimkom sheen makkirin oto, aval bimkom shemmakkirin oto let lan ba. amar rav ashe: uvimkom sheen makkirin oto name, la amaran ella dela mannach tefillin, aval mannach tefillin — let lan ba.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammonea talmido milleshammesho — keillu monea mimmennu chesed, shenneemar: "lammas mereehu chased". rav nachman bar yitzchak omer: af porek mimmennu yirat shamayim, shenneemar: "veyirat shadday yaazov".
Amar rabbi elazar: almana shettafsa mittaltelin bimzonoteha — ma shettafsa tafsa. tanya name hachi: almana shettafsa mittaltelin bimzonoteha — ma shettafsa tafsa.
Vechen ki ata rav dimi, amar: maase bechallato shel rabbi shabbetay shettafsa disakkayya melea maot, velo haya koach beyad chachamim lehotzi miyyadah.
Amar ravina: vela amaran ella limzone, aval lichtubba — mappekinan minna.
Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: may shena lichtubba, demimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli? mezonot name mimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli! ella limzone — may detafsa tafsa, hachi name lichtubba!
Amar leh rav yitzchak bar naftali leravina: hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava kevotaych.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yose ben zimra: almana sheshshahata shetayim veshalosh shanim velo tava mezonot — ibbeda mezonot.
Hasheta shetayim — ibbeda, shalosh mibbaya?! la kashya: kan baaniyya, kan baashira.
I name: kan bifrutza, kan bitznua.
Amar rava: la amaran ella lemafrea, aval lehabba yesh lah.
Bae rabbi yochanan: yetomim omrim natannu, vehi omeret lo natalti, al mi lehavi reaya?
b: Nichse bechezkat yatme kayymi veal almana lehavi reaya, o dilma nichse bechezkat almana kayymi, veal hayyetomim lehavi reaya.
Ta shema, detane levi: almana, kol zeman shello nisset — al hayyetomim lehavi reaya. nisset — aleha lehavi reaya.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe, ketannae: mocheret, vechotevet: "ellu limzonot macharti" veellu lichtubba macharti", divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: mocheret vechotevet setam, vechen kochah yafe.

May lav beha kamippalgi, lerabbi yehuda deamar bae lefaroshe, savar: nichse bechezkat yatme kayymi, veal haalmana lehavi reaya. verabbi yose savar: la bae lefaroshe, nichse bechezkat almana kayymi, veal hayyetomim lehavi reaya.
Mimmay? dilma dechulle alma nichse bechezkat almana kayymi, veal hayyetomim lehavi reaya, verabbi yehuda etza tova ka mashma lan — dela likro la raavtanuta.

Dei la tema hachi, ha devae rabbi yochanan, tifshot leh mimmatnitin: mocheret limzonot shello bevet din, vechotevet: "ellu limzonot macharti"! ella mimmatnitin lekka lemishma minna, deetza tova ka mashma lan. hachi name etza tova ka mashma lan.

I name: dechulle alma nichse bechezkat yatme kayymi, vehayeynu tama derabbi yose — kidabbaye kashshisha. deamar abbaye kashshisha, mashal derabbi yose lema haddavar dome? lishchiv mera sheamar "tenu matayim zuz lifloni baal chovi", ratza — bechovo notlan, ratza — bemattana notlan.

a: Im bemattana notlan lo kach yafe kocho.

Ketzad mocheret? amar rabbi daniel bar rav kattina amar rav huna: mocheret achat lishnem asar chodesh, velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom. verav yehuda amar: mocheret leshishsha chodashim, velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom.
Tanya kevoteh derav huna: mocheret lishnem asar chodesh, velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom. tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: mocheret leshishsha chodashim, velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom.
Amar ammemar, hilcheta: mocheret leshishsha chodashim velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: derav huna may? amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar: la sevira li.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: mocheret limzonot, mahu shettachazor vetitrof lichtubba?
Kamibbaya lehu bidrav yosef. deamar rav yosef: armalta dezabben — achrayut ayyatme, uve dina dezabben — achrayut ayyatme. may?
Kevan deachrayut ayyatme, tarfa, o dilma matze amri la: nehi deachrayut dealma la kabbelt illavach, achrayut denafshach mi la kabbole kabbelt?
Amar leh, tenetuha: mocheret veholechet ad kede chetubbatah, vesemech lah shettigbe ketubbatah min hashshear. shema minna: shayyayra — in, la shayyayra — la.
Vedilma etza tova ka mashma lan, dela likro la haderanita. im ken, litne: "gova ketubbatah min hashshear", may "semech lah"? shema minna: shayyayra — in, la shayyayra — la.
Ibbaya lehu: zabben vela itzterichu leh zuze, hadri zevine, o la hadri zevine?
Ta shema: dehahu gavra dezabben ara lerav pappa, deitzterichu leh zuze lemizban tore. lesof la itzterichu leh, veahderay nihaleh rav pappa leareh. rav pappa lifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad.
Ta shema: dehahu bitztzureta dahavat binhardea, zabbeninhu kulle alma leappadnayyhu, lesof ato chitte. amar lehu rav nachman: dina hu dehadri appadne lemarayyhu.
Hatam name: zevine betaut havo, deiggallay milleta dearba beikkule hava kayyma.

I hachi, hayeynu daamar leh rame bar shemuel lerav nachman: im ken nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo! amar leh: attu kol yoma bitztzureta shechicha? amar leh: in, bitztzureta binhardea mishkach shechicha.
Vehilcheta: zabben vela itzterichu leh zuze — hadri zevine.
Mishna almana, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin — mocheret shello bevet din.
Rabbi shimon omer: min hannissuin mocheret shello bevet din, min haerusin lo timkor ella bevet din, mippene sheen lah mezonot. vechol sheen lah mezonot — lo timkor ella bevet din.
Gemara bishlama min hannissuin — mishshum mezone,
b: Ella min haerusin may tama? amar ulla: mishshum chinna. rabbi yochanan amar: lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu gerusha. leman deamar mishshum chinna — gerusha name baaya chen, leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din — gerusha la ichpat leh.
Tenan: ugerusha lo timkor ella bevet din. bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din — gerusha la ichpat leh. ella leman deamar mishshum chinna, gerusha name baaya chen!
Ha manni — rabbi shimon hi.
I rabbi shimon, ha tena leh resha: min haerusin lo timkor kulei?
Mahu detema: almana min haerusin hu dela nefish chen dida, aval gerusha dinfish chen dida, ema tibbee chen.
Ha name tenena: "kol sheen lah mezonot". leetoye may? lav leetoye gerusha?
La, leetoye "megoreshet veenah megoreshet" — kidrabbi zera. deamar rabbi zera: kol makom sheamru megoreshet veenah megoreshet — baal chayyayv bimzonoteha.

Ta shema: keshem shemmocheret shello bevet din, kach yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah mochrim shello bevet din. bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din, ki hechi deihi la nicha leh detitbazze — yorsheha name la nicha leh delibbazzu, ella leman deamar mishshum chinna, yorsheha may chen ikka? targema ulla: kegon sheyyerashatta bittah o achotah.

Mishna machra ketubbatah o miktzatah, mishkena ketubbatah o miktzatah, natna ketubbatah leacher o miktzatah — lo timkor et hashshear ella bevet din. vachachamim omrim: mocheret hi afillu arbaa vachamishsha peamim. umocheret limzonot shello bevet din, vechotevet "limzonot macharti". ugerusha lo timkor ella bevet din.

Gemara matnitin manni? rabbi shimon hi. detanya: machra ketubbatah, mishkena ketubbatah, asta ketubbatah appoteke leacher — en lah mezonot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer: af al pi shello machra velo mishkena ketubbatah ella machatzitah — ibbeda mezonoteha.
Lememra derabbi shimon savar dela amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef, verabbanan savri amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef?
Ha ippecha shaminan lehu! detanya: "vehu ishsha bivtuleha" — perat levogeret shekkalu betuleha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret.
Hatam bikrae peligi. rabbi meir savar: "betula" — afillu miktzat betulim. "betuleha" — ad deikka kullehu betulim. "bivtuleha", bichdarkah — in, shello kedarkah — la.
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri: "betula" — shelema mashma, "betuleha" — afillu miktzat betulim.

a: "Bivtuleha" — sheyyehu kol betuleha kayymin, ben bichdarkah ben shello kedarkah.

Hahi itteta ditfasa kasa dechaspa bichtubbeta, katava mezone. atay lekammeh derava. amar lehu leyatme: zilu havu la mezonot, let dechash leha derabbi shimon, deamar: la amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef.
Shelach leh rabba bereh derava lerav yosef: mocheret shello bevet din tzericha shevua, o en tzericha shevua? vetibbee lach hacheraza?!
Amar leh: hacheraza la kamibbaya li, deamar rabbi zera amar rav nachman: almana sheshshama leatzmah — lo asta velo kelum.
Hechi dame? i deachruz — ammay lo asta velo kelum? ella lav, dela achruz, uleatzmah hu delo asta velo kelum, ha leacher — ma sheasta asta.
Leolam deachruz, udeamri la: man sham lich?
Ki hay dehahu gavra deafkidu gabbeh kista deyatme. azal, shama lenafsheh bearba mea zuze. iyyaykkar kam beshet mea.
Ata lekammeh derabbi amme. amar leh: man sham lach?
Vehilcheta: tzericha shevua veenah tzericha hacheraza.
Mishna almana shehayta ketubbatah matayim, umachra shave mane bematayim, o shave matayim bemane — nitkabbela ketubbatah.
Hayta ketubbatah mane, umachra shave mane vedinar bemane — michrah batel. afillu hi omeret achzir dinar layyorshin — machra batel.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leolam michrah kayyaym, ad shettehe sham kede shetteshayyer besade — bat tisha kabbin, uveginna — bat chatzi kav, uchedivre rabbi akiva — bet rova.
Hayta ketubbatah arba meot zuz umachra laze bemane, velaze bemane, velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane — shel acharon batel, veshel kullan michran kayyaym.
Gemara may shena shave matayim bemane — deamri la: at afsedt, shave mane bematayim name, tema: ana arvavchna!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu:
b: Kan shana rabbi, hakkol levaal hammaot, kidtanya: hosifu lo achat yetera, hakkol lashshaliach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: cholkin.
Vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: hakkol levaal hammaot! amar rame bar chama: la kashya. kan bedavar sheyyesh lo kitzva, kan bedavar sheen lo kitzva.
Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: davar sheyyesh lo kitzva — cholkin, davar sheen lo kitzva — hakkol levaal hammaot. may ka mashma lan? shinnuya deshanninan shinnuya hu.
Ibbaya lehu, amar leh: zabben li litka, vaazal vezabben leh kora, may? mosif al devarav hu, velitka miha kane, o dilma maavir al devarav hu, velitka name la kane?
Amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina: ta shema, amar baal habbayit lishlucho: "ten lahen chaticha laorchin", vehu omer: "telu shetayim", vehen natlu shalosh — kullan maalu.

I amrat bishlama mosif al devarav have — mishshum hachi baal habbayit maal. ella i amrat maavir al devarav have — baal habbayit ammay maal? vehatnan: hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto — baal habbayit maal, lo asa shelichuto — shaliach maal!
Hacha bemay askinan, deamar lehu: "telu achat middato shel baal habbayit, veachat middati", ushekalu inhu telat.
Ta shema: hayta ketubbatah mane, umachra shave mane vedinar bemane — michrah batel.
May lav dezabben shave mane vedinar bemane vedinar, umay "bemane" — mane shellah. umay "afillu"? afillu hi omeret "achzir et haddinar layyorshim bedinar mekarkee", vekatane: michrah batel.
Amar rav huna bereh derav natan: la, bidozel.

a: Ha middesefa bidozel have, resha bidla ozel, dekatane sefa: hayta ketubbatah arba meot zuz, machra laze bemane velaze bemane, velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane — shel acharon michrah batel, veshel kullan michran kayyaym!
La, resha vesefa bidozel, vesefa ha ka mashma lan: tama deozel bidyatme, aval bedida — michrah kayyaym.
Ha midderesha shamat minna: hayta ketubbatah matayim, umachra shave mane bematayim, o shave matayim bemane — nitkabbela ketubbatah.
Mahu detema: hatam hu deistallaka la mehay beta ligmare, aval hacha nigzor mane rishon attu mane acharon — ka mashma lan.
Veikka deamri: ha la tibbee lach hecha daamar leh "zil zabben li litka" vezabben leh kora, devadday mosif al devarav have.
Ki tibbee lach daamar leh: "zil zabben li kora" vaazal vezabben leh litka, may? mi amrinan amar leh: detava lach avadi lach, dei la mitztarchi lach zuze, la matzet hadrat beh.
O dilma amar leh: la nicha li delippushu shetare illavay.
Amar rabbi chanina missura, ta shema: natan lo dinar shel zahav veamar lo: "have li chaluk", vehalach vehevi lo beshalosh chaluk uveshalosh tallit — shenehem maalu.
I amrat bishlama: sheliach ki hay gavvna ose shelichuto, umosif al devarav have — mishshum hachi baal habbayit maal, ella i amrat: maavir al devarav have — ammay maal?
Hacha bemay askinan — deayyti leh shave shesh beshalosh.
I hachi, shaliach ammay maal? attallit.
I hachi ema sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: af baze baal habbayit lo maal, mippene sheyyachol lomar: chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh, veatta heveta li chaluk katan vara.
May "ra"? ra bedamim, deamar leh: i ayytet li beshet, kol shekken dahava shave tarte sere.
Dayka name, dekatane: mode rabbi yehuda bekitnit sheshshenehem maalu,
b: Shehakkitnit besela, vekitnit bifruta. shema minna.
Hechi dame? illema beatra dimzabbeni beshuma, hecha deyahev leh sela — mozli gabbeh tefe!
Amar rav pappa: beatra dechayyli bechanne, deamar leh: "kanna kanna bifruta".
Ta shema: hayta ketubbatah arba meot zuz, machra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane — shel acharon batel, veshel kullan michran kayyaym.
Kidamar rav shisha bereh derav idi, bekattine, hacha name bekattine.
Peshita, amar "leechad, velo lishnayim" — haamar leh "leechad velo lishnayim". amar leh "leechad" setama, may?
Rav huna amar: "leechad", velo lishnayim. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayyhu: "leechad", vaafillu lishnayim. "leechad", vaafillu lemea.
Ikkela rav nachman lesura, ul legabbeh rav chisda verabba bar rav huna, amaru leh: ki hay gavvna may? amar lehu: "leechad" vaafillu lishnayim, "leechad" vaafillu lemea.
Amaru leh: af al gav dita shaliach? amar lehu: dita shaliach la kaamena. amaru leh: vehaamar mar en onaa lekarkaot!
Hane mille hecha dita baal habbayit, aval tea shaliach, amar leh: "letakkone shaddartaycha vela leauote".
Umena temra deshane ben shaliach levaal habbayit?
Ditnan: haomer lishlucho tze uterom — torem kedaat baal habbayit. veim eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit — torem bevenonit echad mechamishshim, pichet asara o hosif asara — terumato teruma.
Veillu gabbe baal habbayit tanya: taram veala beyado afillu echad meesrim — terumato teruma.
Ta shema: hayta ketubbatah arba meot zuz, machra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon shave mane vedinar bemane — shel acharon batel, veshel kullan michran kayyaym.
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: bekattine.
Mishna shum haddayyaynin sheppichatu shetut o hosifu shetut — michran batel.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: michran kayyaym. im ken — ma koach bet din yafe? aval im asu iggeret bikkoret benehen, afillu machru shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane — michran kayyaym.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: shaliach, keman?

a: Rava amar rav nachman: shaliach kedayyaynin. rav shemuel bar bisna amar rav nachman: kealmana.
Rava amar rav nachman: shaliach kedayyaynin. ma dayyaynin lav ledidhu — af shaliach name lav ledideh, leappoke almana dildida.
Rav shemuel bar bisna amar rav nachman: kealmana, ma almana yechida — af shaliach yachid, leappoke bet din — derabbim ninhu. vehilcheta, shaliach kealmana.

Umay shena meha ditnan: haomer lishlucho "tze uterom" — torem kedaat baal habbayit, veim eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit — torem bevenonit echad mechamishshim. pichet asara o hosif asara, terumato teruma.
Hatam kevan deikka detorem beayin raa veikka detorem beayin yafa, amar leh: lehachi amadtaych. aval hacha tauta hu, amar leh: la ibbei lach lemite.

Amar rav huna bar chanina amar rav nachman, halacha kedivre chachamim: velet leh lerav nachman ma koach bet din yafe? vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel: yetomim shebbau lachlok benichse avihen — bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos, uvorrin lahem chelek yafe. higdilu — yecholin lemachot. verav nachman dideh amar: higdilu — en yecholin lemachot, im ken ma koach bet din yafe.
La kashya: ha dito, ha dela teo.
I dela teo, bemay yecholin lemachot? beruchot.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: maase veasa rabbi kedivre chachamim, amar lefanav parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol: im ken ma koach bet din yafe, vehechzir rabbi et hammaase.

Rav dimi matne hachi, rav safra matne hachi: maase uvikkesh rabbi laasot kedivre chachamim, amar lefanav parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol: im ken ma koach bet din yafe? lo asa rabbi et hammaase.
Lema beha kamippalgi, mar savar: taa bidvar mishna — chozer, umar savar: eno chozer.
La, dechulle alma taa bidvar mishna chozer, umar savar hachi hava maase, umar savar hachi hava maase.
Amar rav yosef: armalta dezabbina — achrayut ayyatme. uvet din dezabben — achrayut ayyatme.
Peshita!
Almana la itztericha leh. ki itzterich leh, be dina — mahu detema:
b: Kol dezaven mibbe dina — addata lemippak leh kala hu dezaven, ka mashma lan.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kulei. vead kamma? amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: ad palga.
Tanya name hachi, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bet din shemmachru shave matayim bemane o shave mane bematayim — michran kayyaym.
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav yosef: bet din shemmachru belo hacheraza — naasu kemi shettau bidvar mishna vechozrin.
Naasu? vadday tau! ditnan: shum hayyetomin sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaerev.
I mehahi hava amena hane mille shaliach, aval bet din — la, ka mashma lan.
Etiveh rav ashe leammemar: shum haddayyaynin sheppichatu shetut o hotiru shetut — michran batel. ha shave beshave — michran kayyaym. may lav dela achruz? la, bidachruz.
Ha middesefa bidachruz have, resha bidla achruz, dekatane sefa: im asu iggeret bikkoret, afillu machru shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane — michran kayyaym.
Ella, leolam bidla achruz, vela kashya: kan bidvarim shemmachrizin alehen, kan bidvarim sheen machrizin alehen.
Veellu hen devarim sheen machrizin alehen: haavadim vehammittaltelin vehashshetarot. avadim tama may? shemma yishmeu veyivrechu. mittaltelin ushetarot — shemma yigganvu.
Veibbaet ema: kan beshaa shemmachrizin, kan beshaa sheen machrizin.
Deamri nehardae: lichraga limzone velikvura — mezabbeninan bela achrazta.
Veibbaet ema: kan bimkom shemmachrizin, kan bimkom sheen machrizin. deamar rav nachman: meolam lo asu iggeret bikkoret binhardea.
Sevur minna mishshum divkie beshuma. amar leh rav yosef bar minyome: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav nachman, mishshum dekaru lehu "bene achli nichse deachrazta".
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mittaltelin shel yetomim — shamin otan umochrin otan lealtar. rav chisda amar avimi: mochrin otan lishvavkim.
Vela peligi: ha — dimykarav shuka, ha — dimrachak shuka.
Rav kahana hava bideh shichra derav mesharsheya bar chilkay yatma. shahayeh ad rigla, amar: af al gav denafel beh itztzata, mayyte zuza charifa.
Ravina hava bideh chamra deravina zute yatma bar achateh. hava ledideh name chamra, hava kamassek leh lesichra.
Ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: mahu leamtoye bahadan? amar leh: zil, la adif middidach.
Mishna hamemaenet, hashsheniyya, vehaaylonit — en lahen ketubba, velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot.
Im mittechilla nesaah leshem aylonit — yesh lah ketubba.
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer — yesh lahem ketubba.
Gemara rav tane: ketanna — yotza beget en lah ketubba. vechol shekken memaenet.
Shemuel tane: memaenet — en lah ketubba, aval yotza beget — yesh lah ketubba.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: memaenet — en lah ketubba, yotza beget — yesh lah ketubba.
Memaenet — lo pesalah min haachin, velo pesalah min hakkehunna. yotza beget — pesalah min haachin, ufesalah min hakkehunna.
Memaenet enah tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim,

a: Yotza beget tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim.

May ka mashma lan? tenena kullehu: hamemaenet beish — hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo pesalah min hakkehunna. natan lah get — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna.
Tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim itztericha leh, dela tenan.

Lema ketannae, rabbi eliezer omer: en maase ketanna kelum, veen balah zakkay bimtziatah, velo bemaase yadeha, velo bahafarat nedareha, veeno yorshah, veeno mittamme lah. kelalo shel davar: enah keishto lechol davar, ella shetztzericha meun.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: maase ketanna kelum, uvalah zakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha, veyorshah, umittamme lah. kelalo shel davar: hare hi keishto lechol davar, ella sheyyotza bemeun.
Lema rav deamar kerabbi eliezer ushemuel deamar kerabbi yehoshua?
Allibba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la peligi.
Ki peligi allibba derabbi yehoshua: shemuel kerabbi yehoshua, verav: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella middida ledideh, aval middideh ledida — la.
Velo belaot. amar leh rav huna bar chiyyay lerav kahana: amart lan mishshemeh dishmuel: lo shanu ella nichse melog, aval nichse tzon barzel, it la.
Have ba rav pappa: aheyay? illema ammemaenet, i deitanhu — idde veidde shakla. vei deletanhu — idde veidi la shakla!
Ella aayylonit: i deitanhu — idde veidde shakla, i deletanhu — ippecha mibbee leh: nichse melog devirshuta kayymi — it la, nichse tzon barzel delav birshuta kayymi — let la!
Ella ashsheniyya, ukenasu rabbanan ledida bedideh uledideh bedida.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe, shema minna midderav kahana: ayyila leh gelima — karna have, vela mikkasse la veazel ad devale.
Vehaamar rav nachman pera have! derav nachman peliga.
En lahen ketubba. amar shemuel: lo shanu ella mane matayim, aval tosefet, yesh lahen.
Tanya name hachi: nashim sheamru chachamim en lahen ketubba, kegon hamemaenet vechavroteha — en lahen mane matayim, aval tosefet — yesh lahen.
Nashim sheamru chachamim yotzot shello bichtubba, kegon overet al dat vechavroteha — en lahen tosefet, vechol shekken mane matayim. vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra — notelet ma shellefaneha veyotza.
Mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: zinneta lo hifsida
b: Belaoteha kayyaymin.
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: zinneta — hifsida belaoteha kayyaymin. amar leh: im hi zinneta, keleha mi zannay? tane: lo hifsida belaoteha kayyaymin.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi menachem setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim: zinneta — lo hifsida belaoteha kayyaymin.
Im mittechilla nasa kulei. amar rav huna: aylonit — ishsha veenah ishsha, almana — ishsha gemura.
Aylonit ishsha veenah ishsha: hikkir bah — yesh lah ketubba, lo hikkir bah — en lah ketubba. almana ishsha gemura: ben hikkir bah, ben lo hikkir bah — yesh lah ketubba.
Verav yehuda omer: achat zo veachat zo ishsha veenah ishsha. hikkir bah — yesh lah ketubba, lo hikkir bah — en lah ketubba.
Metivi: kenasah bechezkat shehi ken, venimtzet shehi ken — yesh lah ketubba. ha setama — en lah ketubba.
La tema: ha setama en lah ketubba, ella ema: kenasah bechezkat sheenah ken, venimtzet shehi ken — en lah ketubba.
Aval setama may — it la, addetane bechezkat shehi ken venimtzet shehi ken yesh lah ketubba, lashmeinan setama, vechol shekken ha!
Veod, tane: kenasah beyadua venimtzet beyadua — yesh lah ketubba, kenasah setam — en lah ketubba. teyuveta derav huna!
Rav huna matnitin atiteh. hu savar: middeka mefalleg beaylonit vela kamfalleg bealmana, mikkelal dealmana afillu bistama name it la, vela hi: ki katane la lealmana, appelugeta deaylonit kae.
Hadaran alach almana nizzonet
Hannose et haishsha ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim — chayyayv lezunah chamesh shanim.
Nisset leacher, ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim chayyayv lezunah chamesh shanim. lo yomar harishon: lichshettavo etzli ezunah, ella molich lah mezonoteha lammakom sheimmah.
Vechen lo yomru shenehem "hare anu zanin otah keechad", ella echad zana, veechad noten lah deme mezonot.
Nisset — habbaal noten lah mezonot, vehen notnin lah deme mezonot. metu — benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin, vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshuebadim, mippene shehi kevaalat chov.
Happikkechim hayu kotvim: al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheat immi.
Gemara ittemar: haomer lachavero "chayyayv ani lecha mane". rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, veresh lakish amar: patur.
Hechi dame? i deamar lehu "attem edayy", may tama deresh lakish dekafatar! i dela amar lehu "attem edayy", may tama derabbi yochanan dekamchayyev?

Leolam dela kaamar lehu "attem edayy", vehacha bemay askinan — deamar leh "chayyayv ani lecha mane bishtar". rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv — allima milleta dishtara keman deamar lehu "attem edim" dame. resh lakish amar: patur, la allima milleta dishtara.
Tenan: hannose et haishsha ufaska immo lazun et bittah chamesh shanim, chayyayv lezunah chamesh shanim. may lav ki hay gavvna?

a: La, bishtare fesikata, vechidrav giddel.
Deamar rav giddel amar rav: kamma atta noten levincha? kach vechach. vechamma atta noten levittecha? kach vechach. amdu vekiddeshu — kanu. hen hen haddevarim hanniknin baamira.
Ta shema, katav lechohen: "sheani chayyayv lecha chamesh selaim" — chayyayv litten lo chamesh selaim, uveno eno paduy.
Shane hatam dimshuebad leh middeorayyta: i hachi, ammay katav? kede levarer lo kohen.
I hachi, beno ammay eno paduy? kidulla. deamar ulla: devar tora — paduy lichsheyyitten, umay tama amru beno eno paduy? gezera shemma yomru podin bishtarot.
Amar rava, ketannae: arev hayyotze achar chittum shetarot — gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Maase ba lifne rabbi yishmael, veamar: gove minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo ben nannas: eno gove lo minnechasim bene chorin velo minnechasim meshuebadim.
Amar lo: lamma? amar lo: hare shehaya chonek et chavero bashshuk, umetza[vo] chavero veamar lo: hannach lo, vaani etten lach — patur, shello al emunato hilvahu.
Lema rabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi yishmael, veresh lakish deamar keven nannas.
Allibba deven nannas kulle alma la peligi,
b: Ki peligi allibba derabbi yishmael. rabbi yochanan kerabbi yishmael, veresh lakish — ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam ella deshayech leh leshibuda deorayyta, aval hacha la shayech shibuda deorayyta.
Gufa, amar rav giddel amar rav: "kamma atta noten levincha?", "kach vechach". "vechamma atta noten levittecha?", "kach vechach". amdu vekiddeshu kanu, hen hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira.
Amar rava: mistabbera milleta derav bevitto naara — deka mate hanaa lideh, aval bogeret dela mate hanaa lideh — la.
Vehaelohim! amar rav: afillu bogeret. dei la tema hachi, avi habben may hanaa ata lideh? ella behahi hanaa dekamichatteni ahadade gamri umakni lahadade.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: devarim hallalu nittenu likkatev, o lo nittenu likkatev? amar leh: lo nittenu likkatev.
Etiveh: happikchin hayu kotvin "al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheat immi"! may "kotvin" — omrim.
Vekare leh laamira ketiva? in, vehatnan: hakkotev leishto "din udevarim en li binchasayich", vetane rabbi chiyyay: haomer leishto.
Ta shema: en kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem. ha middaat shenehem kotvin. may lav shetare fesikata!
La, shetare erusin mammash. kidrav pappa verav sherevya. deittemar: ketavo lishmah, veshello middatah — rabba veravina amri: mekuddeshet, rav pappa verav sherevya amri: enah mekuddeshet.
Ta shema: metu — benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin, vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshuebadim, mippene shehi kevaalat chov.
Hacha bemay askinan — beshekkanu miyyado.
I hachi, banot name! beshekkanu lazo velo kanu lazo.
Umay paska? ihi dahavay bishat kinyan — mahane la kinyan, banot dela havo bishat kinyan — la mahane lehu kinyan.
Mi la askinan dahavay bishat kinyan, vehechi dame — kegon degarsha veahdera!
Ella: ihi deleta bitnay bet din — mahane la kinyan, banot deitanhu bitnay bet din — la mahane lehu kinyan.
Migra gari? ella: benotav hayeynu tama — kevan deitanhu bitnay bet din, emar tzerare etpesinhu.
Lo yomar harishon. amar rav chisda: zot omeret bat etzel immah.
Mimmay devigdola askinan? dilma biktanna askinan, umishshum maase shehaya.

Detanya: mi shemmet vehinniach ben katan leimmo, yorshe haav omrim: yehe gadel etzlenu, veimmo omeret: yehe beni gadel etzli — mannichin oto etzel immo, veen mannichin oto etzel rauy leyorsho. maase haya ushechatuhu erev happesach!
Im ken litne lemakom shehi,

a: May limkom sheimmah? shamat minna bat etzel haem, la shena gedola vela shena ketanna.
Lo yomru shenehem vechulei.
Hahu gavra deogar leh richya lechavreh litchina. lesof iattar, zeven richya vechamra,
Amar leh: ad haiddana hava tachenna gabbach, hasheta hav li agra. amar leh: mitchan tachenna lach.
Sevar ravina lememar: hayeynu matnitin lo yomru shenehem "hare anu zanin otah keechad", ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot.
Amar leh rav avvira: mi dame? hatam, chad keresa it la, tarte keresata let la. hacha matze amar leh: techon vezabben, techon veotev.
Vela amaran ella delet leh techina lerichya, aval it leh techina lerichya — kegon zo kofin oto al middat sedom.
Mishna almana sheamra: i efshi lazuz mibbet bali — en hayyorshin yecholin lomar lah: "lechi levet avich veanu zanin otach", ella zanin otah, venotnin lah mador lefi kevodah.
Amra: "i efshi lazuz mibbet abba" — yecholin hayyorshin lomar lah: im at etzlenu — yesh lich mezonot, veim en at etzlenu en lich mezonot.
Im hayta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehen yeladim — zanin otah vehi bevet aviha.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mishtammeshet bammador kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah. baavadim ushefachot kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah. becharim uchesatot kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah. bichle chesef uvichle zahav kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah. shekkach katav lah: "veat tehe yatvat beveti umittazna minnichsay kol yeme megar armelutich beveti".
Tane rav yosef: "beveti" — velo bevikti.
Amar rav nachman: yetomim shemmachru medor almana — lo asu velo kelum.
Umay shena midderabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan? deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: yetomim shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin — ma shemmachru machru.
Hatam la mishtabedi la mechayyim, hacha mishtabedi la mechayyim.
Amar abbaye, nekitinan: medor almana shennafal — en hayyorshin chayyayvin livnoto,
Tanya name hachi: medor almana shennafal — en hayyorshin chayyayvin livnoto. velo od, ella afillu hi omeret "hannichuni veevnennu mishshelli" — en shomin lah.
Bae abbaye: shippetza, may? teku.
Amra i efshi.
Velittevu la ki yatva hatam? mesayyay leh lerav huna. deamar rav huna: birkat habbayit berubba.
Velittevu la lefi birkat habbayit? hachi name.
Amar rav huna: leshon chachamim beracha, leshon chachamim osher, leshon chachamim marpe. beracha ha daamaran.
Osher, ditnan: hammocher perot lachavero, mashach velo madad — kana, madad velo mashach — lo kana. veim haya pikkeach — socher et mekomo.
Marpe, ditnan: lo yilos adam chittin veyanniach al gabbe makkato bappesach, mippene shemmachmitzot.

Tanu rabbanan, bishat petirato shel rabbi, amar: levanay ani tzarich. nichnesu banav etzlo. amar lahem: hizzaharu bichvod immechem. ner yehe daluk bimkomo, shulechan yehe aruch bimkomo, mitta tehe mutztzaat bimkomah. yosef chofni shimon efrati hem shimmeshuni bechayyay, vehem yeshammeshuni bemoti.
Hizzaharu bichvod immechem. deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "kabbed et avicha veet immecha"! eshet av havay.
Eshet av name deorayyta hi, detanya: "kabbed et avicha veet immecha", "et avicha" — zo eshet avicha, "veet immecha" — zo baal immecha, vav yetera — lerabbot et achicha haggadol!
Hane mille mechayyim, aval leachar mita la.
"Ner yehe daluk bimkomo, shulechan yehe aruch bimkomo, mitta tehe mutztzaat bimkomah", may tama? kol be shimshe hava ate leveteh.
Hahu be shimsha atay shivavta, ka karya abbava, amara ammeteh: shetiku, derabbi yatev. kevan dishma, shuv la ata, shello lehotzi laaz al tzaddikim harishonim.

"Yosef chofni shimon efrati, hem shimmeshuni bechayyay vehem yeshammeshuni bemoti". sevur minna behaden alma hu dekaamar, kevan dachazo dekadem arsayyhu learseh, amri: shema minna lehahu alma hu dekaamar.
Vehay daamar hachi — dela lemru: milleta havay lehu vead haiddana name zechuto derabbi hu deahanya lehu.
Amar lahen: lechachme yisrael ani tzarich. nichnesu etzlo chachme yisrael, amar lahen: "al tispeduni baayayrot,
b: Vehoshivu yeshiva leachar sheloshim yom". "shimon beni chacham, gamliel beni nasi, chanina bar chama yeshev barosh".
Al tispeduni baayayrot — sevur minna mishshum tircha hu dekaamar. kevan dachazo dekasafdi bichrakkim vekaatu kulle alma, amru: shema minna mishshum yekara hu dekaamar.

Hoshivu yeshiva leachar sheloshim yom — dela adifna mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv: "vayyivku vene yisrael et moshe bearvot moav sheloshim yom", telatin yomin safdin bimama velelya, mikkan veelach safdu bimama vegarsi belelya, o safdu belelya vegarsi bimama, ad desafdi teresar yarche shatta.

Hahu yoma deashkavteh derabbi nefaka bat kala vaamara: kol dahava beashkavteh derabbi, mezumman hu lechayye haolam habba. hahu koves kol yoma hava ate kammeh, hahu yoma la ata. kevan dishma hachi, selek leiggara unefal leara umit. yatzta bat kol veamra: af hahu koves mezumman hu lechayye haolam habba.
Shimon beni chacham — may kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al pi sheshshimon beni chacham, gamliel beni nasi.
Amar levi: tzericha lememar? amar rabbi shimon bar rabbi: tzericha lach ulematlatach. may kashya leh — ha kera kaamar: "veet hammamlacha natan lihoram ki hu habbechor"!
Hahu, memalle mekom avotav hava, verabban gamliel eno memalle mekom avotav hava.
Verabbi may tama avad hachi? nehi deeno memalle mekom avotav bechochma — beyirat chet memalle mekom avotav hava.
Chanina bar chama yeshev barosh — lo kibbel rabbi chanina, shehaya rabbi appas gadol mimmennu shete shanim umechetza. yetev rabbi appas beresha vitev rabbi chanina abbaray, vaata levi vitev gabbeh.

Nach nafsheh derabbi appas vitev rabbi chanina beresha, vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh, vekaate levavel. vehayeynu deamri leh lerav: gavra rabba ikkela linhardea umatla vedaresh kelila shere. amar: shema minna nach nafsheh derabbi appas, vitev rabbi chanina beresha, vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh, vekaate.
Veema, rabbi chanina nach nafsheh verabbi appas keditev yetev, vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh vekaate? ibbaet ema: levi lerabbi appas mikkaf hava kayif leh.
Vei baet ema: kevan deamar "rabbi chanina bar chama yeshev barosh" — la saggi dela malech, dichtiv behu betzaddikim: "vetigzar omer veyakom lach".
Veha hava rabbi chiyyay! nach nafsheh. vehaamar rabbi chiyyay: ani raiti kivro shel rabbi, vehoradti alav demaot! efoch.
Vehaamar rabbi chiyyay: oto hayyom shemmet rabbi batla kedushsha! efoch.

Vehatanya: keshechala rabbi, nichnas rabbi chiyyay etzlo umetzao shehu boche, amar lo: rabbi, mippene ma atta boche? vehatanya: met mittoch hassechok — siman yafe lo, mittoch habbechi — siman ra lo. panav lemala — siman yafe lo, panav lematta — siman ra lo. panav kelappe haam — siman yafe lo, kelappe hakkotel — siman ra lo. panav yerukkin — siman ra lo, panav tzehubbin vaadummim — siman yafe lo. met beerev shabbat — siman yafe lo. bemotzae shabbat — siman ra lo. met beerev yom hakkippurim — siman ra lo, bemotzae yom hakkippurim — siman yafe lo. met mecholi meayim — siman yafe lo, mippene sherubbam shel tzaddikim mitatan becholi meayim.
Amar leh: ana attora umitzvot ka vachena!
Ibbaet ema efoch, veibbaet ema leolam la tefoch, rabbi chiyyay asuk bemitzvot hava verabbi savar la afaggereh.
Vehayeynu dechi havo minnetzu rabbi chanina verabbi chiyyay, amar leh rabbi chanina lerabbi chiyyay: bahade didi minnetzet? deim chas veshalom nishtakkecha tora miyyisrael, mahdarna leh mippilpulay.

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay: ana avadi dela mishtachcha tora miyyisrael. deayytina kittana veshadeyna, umegaddelna nishbe, vetzayedna teve(1), umaachelna bisra leyatme, vearechna megilleta mimmashche ditve, vesalekna lemata delet ba makre dardeke, vechatevna chamsha chumeshe lechamsha yanoke, umatnena shitta sidre leshitta yanoke, lechol chad vechad amari leh atni sidrach lechavrach.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi: kamma gedolim maase chiyyay. amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi: afillu mimmecha? amar leh: in. amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: afillu meabba? amar leh: chas veshalom, lo tehe kazot beyisrael.
Amar lahen: livni katan ani tzarich. nichnas rabbi shimon etzlo, masar lo sidre chochma,
Amar lahen: livni gadol ani tzarich. nichnas rabban gamliel etzlo, umasar lo sidre nesiut. amar lo: "beni, nehog nesiutach beramim, zerok mara battalmidim".
Ini? veha ketiv: "veet yire Adonai yechabbed", veamar mar: ze yehoshafat melech yehuda, keshehaya roe talmid chacham haya omed mikkisseo, umechabbeko umenashsheko, vekore lo: rabbi rabbi, mari mari!
La kashya: ha betzina, ha befarhesya.
Tanya: rabbi mutal betzippori, umakom muchan lo bevet shearim. vehatanya: "tzedek tzedek tirdof" — hallech achar rabbi levet shearim!
Rabbi bevet shearim hava, ella kevan dachalash amteyuhi letzippori,

a: Demiddalya uvesim avvera.
Hahu yoma denach nafsheh derabbi, gezaru rabbanan taanita, uveo rachame, veamri: kol man deamar "nach nafsheh derabbi" — yiddaker bacherev.

Selika ammeteh derabbi leiggara, amra: elyonim mevakkeshin et rabbi, vehattachtonim mevakkeshin et rabbi. yehi ratzon sheyyachofu tachtonim et haelyonim. kevan dachazay kamma zimne deayel levet hakkisse vechalatz tefillin umannach lehu vekamitztaar, amara: yehi ratzon sheyyachofu elyonim et hattachtonim.
Vela havo shatki rabbanan millemive rachame. shakla kuza, shadyay meiggara [leara], ishtiku merachame, venach nafsheh derabbi.

Amaru leh rabbanan levar kappara: zil ayyen, azal ashkecheh denach nafsheh. kareh lilvusheh veahdereh lekireh laachoreh, petach vaamar: erellim umetzukim achazu baaron hakkodesh, nitztzechu erellim et hammetzukim, venishba aron hakkodesh. amaru leh: nach nafsheh? amar lehu: attun kaamritu vaana la kaamena.

Bishat petirato shel rabbi zakaf eser etzbeotav kelappe mala, amar: ribbono shel olam! galuy veyadua lefanecha sheyyagati beeser etzbeotay battora, velo neheneti afillu beetzba ketanna. yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyyehe shalom bimnuchati. yatzta bat kol veamra: "yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam".

"Al mishkavcha" mibbee leh! mesayyea leh lerabbi chiyyay bar gammada. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada amar rabbi yose ben shaul: beshaa shehatztzaddik niftar min haolam, omrim malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, tzaddik peloni ba. omer lahem: yavou tzaddikim veyetzu likrato, veomrim lo: "yavo beshalom", yanuchu al mishkevotam.

Amar rabbi elazar: beshaa shehatztzaddik niftar min haolam, shalosh kittot shel malache hashsharet yotzot likrato, achat omeret lo: "bo beshalom", veachat omeret: "holech nichcho", veachat omeret lo: "yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam". beshaa sheharasha neevad min haolam, shalosh kittot shel malache chabbala yotzot likrato, achat omeret: "en shalom amar Adonai larshaim", veachat omeret lo: "lemaatzeva yishkav", veachat omeret lo: "reda vehoshkeva et arelim".

Mishna kol zeman shehi bevet aviha, gova ketubbatah leolam. kol zeman shehi bevet balah, gova ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim. sheyyesh beesrim vechamesh shanim shettaase tova keneged ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel.
Vachachamim omrim: kol zeman shehi bevet balah — gova ketubbatah leolam, kol zeman shehi bevet aviha — gova ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim.
Meta — yorsheha mazkirin ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim.
Gemara amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: aniyyay shebbeyisrael ad esrim vechamesh shanim, umarta bat bayytos ad esrim vechamesh shanim?
Amar leh: lefum gamla shichna.
Ibbaya lehu: lerabbi meir mahu shetteshallesh? teku.
Vachachamim omrim: kol zeman. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: atay kodem shekiat hachamma — gova ketubbatah, leachar shekiat hachamma la gavya? behahi pureta achelta?
Amar leh: in, kol middat chachamim, ken hi. bearbaim sea — tovel, bearbaim sea chaser kuretov — eno yachol litbol bahen.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: heid rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lifne rabbi, sheamar mishshum aviv: lo shanu ella sheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha, aval shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha — gova ketubbatah leolam. verabbi elazar amar: afillu shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha — enah gova ella ad esrim vechamesh shanim.
Metiv rav sheshet: baal chov gove shello behazekara. hechi dame, i dela naket shetara — bemay gave? ella denaket shetara: uvaal chov hu delav bar achole hu, ha almana achelta!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: leolam dela naket shetara, vehacha bemay askinan — keshechayyayv mode.
Vehaamar rabbi ila, shonin: gerusha hare hi kevaal chov. hechi dame? i dela nekita ketubba, bemay gavya? ella lav dinkita ketubba, ugerusha hi delav bat achole hi, ha almana achelta!
Hacha name keshechayyayv mode.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tane rav yehuda bar kaza bematnita deve bar kaza: tava ketubbatah —
b: Hare hi kevattechilla. veim haya shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha — gova ketubbatah leolam.

Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov: yelammedenu rabbenu, kesheshshetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah machloket, o kesheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah? vahalacha kedivre mi?
Shelach leh: besheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah machloket, aval shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah — gova ketubbatah leolam. vahalacha kedivre chachamim.
Ki ata rav dimi: amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: lo shanu ella mane matayim, aval tosefet — yesh lah.
Verabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: afillu tosefet en lah. deamar rabbi ayyvu amar rabbi yannay: tenay ketubba kichtubba dame.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: lo shanu ella mane matayim, aval tosefet yesh lah.
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav huna: amar rav hachi? amar leh: ishtik(50) kaamrat, o ashkeyayn kaamrat? amar leh: ishtik(50) kaamena.
Chamateh derav chiyyay aricha intat achu havay, vealmana bevet aviha havay, vezana esrim vachamesh shenin beve nasha.
Lesof amara leh: hav li mezone. amar la: let lich mezone. hav li ketubba. amar la: la mezone it lich, vela ketubba it.
Tevateh ledina kammeh derabba bar shela. amar leh: ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava? amar leh: zanita esrim vachamesh shanim beve nasha, bechayye demar, divchatfay amtay la.
Amar leh: tama may amur rabbanan: kol zeman shehi bevet balah gova ketubbatah leolam, deamrinan: mishshum kissufa hu dela tava. hacha name: mishshum kissufa hu dela tava, zil hav la.
La ashgach. ketav la adrachta annichse. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: chazi mar hechi danan! amar leh: shappir danach.

Amara leh: i hachi, lezil lahdar li pere demin hahu yoma ad haiddana. amar la: achvi li adrachtich. chazyay dela hava ketivv bah "veishtemodana dinchasim ellu demitana innun". amar la: adrachta lav shappir ketiva.
Amara leh: tezil adrachta, eshkol miyyoma dishlimi yome achrazta ad hasheta. amar la: hane mille hecha dela ketiv tauta beadrachta, aval hecha dichtiv tauta beadrachta — let lan ba.
Amara leh: veha mar hu deamar achrayut taut sofer hu.
Amar la rava: beha lekka lememar taut sofer hu, divha afillu rabba bar shela tae. meikkara hu sevar hane vehane dideh, ma li mehane, ma li mehane,
Vela hi. zimnin deazla umashbecha lehu udevala machsefi, veamar la: shekul didach vehav li didi, veate leappoke laaz al be dina.
Hadaran alach hannose
Shene dayyayne gezerot hayu birushalayim, admon vechanan ben avishalom. chanan omer shene devarim, admon omer shiva. mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, chanan omer:

a: Tishshava bassof, velo tishshava battechilla. nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim, veamru: tishshava battechilla uvassof. amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay: yafe amar chanan, lo tishshava ella bassof.
Gemara ureminhi: shelosha dayyayne gezelot hayu birushalayim: admon ben gadday, vechanan hammitzri, vechanan ben avishalom. kashya telat atteren, kashya gezerot aggezelot!
Bishlama telat atteren la kashya: dachashiv leh — katane, dela chashiv leh — la katane. ella gezerot aggezelot kashya!
