Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shehayu gozrin gezerot al gezelot. kidtanya: kittema netia, rabbi yose omer: gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim omrim: netia bat shenatah — shete chesef, bat shete shanim — arba kesef.

Ureminhi, shelosha dayyayne gezerot hayu birushalayim: admon vechanan venachum! amar rav pappa: man tena nachum — rabbi natan hi. detanya, rabbi natan omer: af nachum hammadi miggozre gezerot shebbirushalayim haya, velo hodu lo chachamim.

Vetu lekka? vehaamar rabbi pinchas amar rabbi oshaya: shelosh meot vetishim vearbaa batte dinin hayu birushalayim, kenegdan batte chenesiyyot, uchenegdan batte midrashot, uchenegdan batte sofrim! dayyaynin tuva havo, vechi kaamrinan — aggozre gezerot kaamrinan.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim hayu notlin secharan tishim vatesha mane mitterumat hallishka, lo ratzu — mosifin lahem. lo ratzu? attu berashshie askinan? ella: lo safku, af al pi shello ratzu — mosifin alehen.
Karna hava shakel istera mizzakkay veistera mechayyayv, vedaen lehu dina. vehechi aved hachi? vehachtiv: "veshochad lo tikkach"!
Vechi tema hane mille hecha dela shakel mittarvayyhu dilma ate leatzloye dina, karna kevan deshakel mittarvayyhu — la ate leatzloye dina, vechi la ate leatzloye dina mi shere?

Vehatanya: "veshochad lo tikkach" ma talmud lomar? im lelammed shello lezakkot et hachayyayv veshello lechayyev et hazzakkay — hare kevar neemar "lo tatte mishpat", ella afillu lezakkot et hazzakkay ulechayyev et hachayyayv amra tora "veshochad lo tikkach"!

Hane mille hecha deshakel betorat shochad, karna betorat agra hava shakel. uvetorat agra mi shere? vehatnan: hannotel sachar ladun — dinav betelin! hane mille agar dina, karna agar betela hava shakel.

Vaagar betela mi shere? vehatanya: mechoar haddayyayn shennotel sachar ladun, ella sheddino din. hechi dame? illema agar dina, dino din? vehatanya: hannotel sachar ladun — dinav betelin! ella agar betela, vekatane: mechoar haddayyayn!
Hane mille betela dela mochcha. karna betela demochcha hava shakel, dahava tahe beambara dechamra veyahavi leh zuza.
Ki ha derav huna ki hava ate dina lekammeh, amar lehu: havu li gavra dedale li bacharikay veedun lechu dina.

Amar rabbi avahu: bo uree kamma semuyot enehen shel mekabbele shochad. adam chash beenav, noten mamon larofe — safek mitrappe safek eno mitrappe. vehen notlin shave peruta umesammin enehen, shenneemar: "ki hashshochad yeavver pikchim".

Tanu rabbanan: "ki hashshochad yeavver ene chachamim", kal vachomer lattippeshin. "visallef divre tzaddikim", kal vachomer larshaim. midde tippeshim ureshaim bene dina ninhu? ella hachi kaamar: "ki hashshochad yeavver ene chachamim", afillu chacham gadol velokeach shochad — eno niftar min haolam belo samyut hallev. "visallef divre tzaddikim",
b: Afillu tzaddik gamur velokeach shochad — eno niftar min haolam belo teruf daat.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: daresh rav nachman bar kohen, may dichtiv "melech bemishpat yaamid aretz veish terumot yehersenna" — im dome dayyayn lemelech, sheeno tzarich lichlum — "yaamid aretz". veim dome lechohen shemmechazzer al haggoranot — "yehersenna".
Amar rabba bar rav shela: hay dayyayna deshael sheelta — pasul lemedan dina. vela amaran ella delet leh leoshole, aval it leh leoshole — let lan ba.
Ini? veha rava shael sheelta middeve bar mariyyon af al gav dela shayyli minneh? hatam leachshovinhu hu devae.

Amar rava: may tama deshucheda? kevan dekabbel leh shucheda minneh, ikkarva leh dateh legabbeh vehave kegufeh, veen adam roe chova leatzmo. may "shochad" — shehu chad. amar rav pappa: la ledun inish dina leman derachem leh, vela leman desane leh. derachem leh — la chaze leh chova, desane leh — la chaze leh zechuta.
Amar abbaye: hay tzureba merabbanan dimrachamin leh bene mata — lav mishshum dimalle tefe, ella mishshum dela mochach lehu bemille dishmayya.

Amar rava, meresh hava amena: hane bene machoza kullehu rachamu li. kevan dahavay dayyayna, amena: minnayyhu sanu li uminnayyhu rachamu li. kevan dachazay deman demichayyayv (leh) haiddana ka zache limchar, amena: im mircham — kullehu rachamu li, i misno — kullehu sanu li.
Tanu rabbanan: "veshochad lo tikkach", eno tzarich lomar shochad mamon, ella afillu shochad devarim name asur, middela ketiv "betza lo tikkach". hechi dame shochad devarim?
Ki ha dishmuel hava avar bemabbara, ata hahu gavra yahev leh yedeh, amar leh: may avidtaych? amar leh: dina it li. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina.

Ammemar hava yatev veka daen dina. perach gadpa aresheh, ata hahu gavra shakleh. amar leh: may avidtaych? amar leh: dina it li. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina. mar ukeva hava shede rukka kammeh, ata hahu gavra kasseyeh, amar leh: may avidtaych? amar leh: dina it li. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina.

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose hava regil ariseh dahava mayyte leh kol maale shabbeta kanta defere. yoma chad ayyti leh bechamsha beshabbeta. amar leh: may shena haiddana? amar leh: dina it li, veamena, aggav orchi ayyte leh lemar. la kabbel minneh. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina.

Otev zuza derabbanan vekadayynin leh. bahade dekaazel veate amar: i bae — taen hachi, vei bae — taen hachi. amar: tippach nafsham shel mekabbele shochad! uma ani shello natalti, veim natalti — shelli natalti, kach, mekabbele shochad — al achat kamma vechamma.

Rabbi yishmael bar elisha ayyti leh hahu gavra reshit haggez. amar leh: mehecha at? amar leh: midduch pelan. umehatam lehacha la hava kohen lemitteva leh? amar leh: dina it li, veamena, aggav orchay ayyte leh lemar. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina, la kabbel minneh.

Otev leh zuga derabbanan vekadayyni leh. bahade dekaazel veate, amar: i bae taen hachi, vei bae taen hachi. amar: tippach nafsham shel mekabbele shochad! uma ani shello natalti, veim natalti — shelli natalti, kach, mekabbele shochad — al achat kamma vechamma.
Rav anan ayyti leh hahu gavra kanta degildane deve gile. amar leh: may avidtaych? amar leh: dina it li. la kabbel minneh. amar leh: pesilna lach ledina.

Amar leh: dina demar la baena, kabbole lekabbel mar dela limnean mar meakrove bikkurim. detanya: "veish ba mibbaal shalisha vayyave leish haelohim lechem bikkurim esrim lechem seorim vecharmel betziklono". vechi elisha ochel bikkurim hava? ella lomar lach: kol hammevi doron letalmid chacham — keillu makriv bikkurim.

Amar leh: kabbole la baenan deekabbel, hasheta deamrat li tama, mekabbelna. shaddereh lekammeh derav nachman, shelach leh: nidayyeyneh mar lehay gavra, daana anan pesilna leh ledina. amar: middishlach li hachi, shema minna kariveh hu. hava kaem dina deyatme kammeh, amar:

a: Hay ase vehay ase — ase dichvod tora adif. sallekeh ledina deyatme veachateh ledineh, kevan dachaza baal dineh yekara deka aved lay, istattum tanateh.
Rav anan hava regil eliyyahu deate gabbeh, dahava matne leh seder deeliyyahu. kevan daavad hachi, istallak. yetev betaanita uvea rachame vaata. ki ata, hava mevaet leh baote.
Vaavad tevuta vitev kammeh ad deappek leh sidreh. vehayeynu deamri: seder deeliyyahu rabba, seder eliyyahu zuta.

Bishne derav yosef hava ritcha. amri leh rabbanan lerav yosef: live mar rachame. amar lehu: hasheta uma elisha dechi havo rabbanan mippatri mikkammeh, havo payyshi tere alfe umatan rabbanan, beiddan ritcha la hava bae rachame, ana eve rachame?

Umimmay defayyshi hachi? dichtiv: "vayyomer mesharto ma etten ze lifne mea ish". may "lifne mea ish"? ilema dechullehu, lifne mea ish bishne vatztzoret tuva havo! ella dechol chad vechad kamme mea ish.

Ki havo mippatri rabbanan mibbe rav, havo payyshi alpa umatan rabbanan. mibbe rav huna, havo payyshi tamne mea rabbanan. rav huna hava daresh bitlesar amorae. ki havo kayymi rabbanan mimmetivta derav huna venaftzi gelimayyhu hava salek avka vechase leh leyoma, veamri bemareva: kamu leh mimmetivta derav huna bavlaa.

Ki mippatri rabbanan mibbe rabba verav yosef, havo payyshi arba mea rabbanan, vekaru lenafshayyhu: "yatme". ki havo mippatri rabbanan mibbe abbaye, veamri la mibbe rav pappa, veamri la mibbe rav ashe, havo payyshi matan rabbanan, vekaru nafshayyhu "yatme deyatme".

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar redifa amar rabbi amme: mevakkere mumin shebbirushalayim, hayu notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: talmide chachamim hamelammedin hilchot shechita lechohanim, hayu notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: talmide chachamim hamelammedim hilchot kemitza lakkohanim, notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: maggihe sefarim shebbirushalayim, hayu notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: nashim haorgot bapparochot, notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka. vaani omer, mikkodshe bedek habbayit. hoil ufarochot tachat binyan asuyot.
Metivi: nashim haorgot bapparochot, uvet garmu al maase lechem happanim, uvet avtinas al maase hakketoret — kullan hayu notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka!

Hatam bidvave. deamar rabbi zera amar rav: shelosh esre parochot hayu bemikdash sheni, sheva keneged shiva shearim, achat lefitcho shel hechol, veachat lefitcho shel ulam. shetayim baddevir, shetayim kenegdan baaliyya.
Tanu rabbanan: nashim hamegaddelot benehen lappara — hayu notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka. abba shaul omer: nashim yekarot shebbirushalayim hayu zanot otan umefarnesot otan.
Bea minneh rav huna merav:
b: Kele sharet mahu sheyyeasu mikkodshe bedek habbayit? tzorech mizbeach ninhu, umikkodshe bedek habbayit atu? o tzorech korban ninhu, umitterumat hallishka hayu osin otan? amar leh: en naasin ella mitterumat hallishka.
Etiveh: "uchechallotam heviu lifne hammelech vihoyada (hakkohen) et shear hakkesef vayyaasehu chelim levet Adonai kele sharet vegomer"!
Amar leh: deakreyaych ketuve la akreyaych nevie, "ach lo yease bet Adonai sippot vegomer ki leose hammelacha yittenuhu".
I hachi, kashu kerae ahadade! la kashya: kan sheggavu vehotiru, kan sheggavu velo hotiru.
Vechi gavu vehotiru may have? amar rabbi avahu: lev bet din matne alehen, im hutzerchu — hutzerchu, veim lav — yehu lichle sharet.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: kele sharet bain mitterumat hallishka, shenneemar: "et shear hakkesef", ezehu kesef sheyyesh lo shirayim — heve omer ze terumat hallishka.
Veema shirayim gufayyhu? kidamar rava: "haola" — ola rishona, hachi name: "hakkesef" — kesef rishon.
Metivi: hakketoret vechol korbenot tzibbur — bain mitterumat hallishka, mizbach hazzahav ulevona uchele sharet — bain mimmotar nesachim.

Mizbach haola, halleshachot vehaazarot — bain mikkodshe bedek habbayit. chutz lechomat haazara — bain mishsheyare halleshachot. zo hi sheshshaninu: chomat hair umigdeloteha vechol tzorche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka.
Tannae hi, ditnan: motar teruma, ma hayu osin bah? rikkue zahav tzippuy levet kodshe hakkodashim, rabbi yishmael omer: motar perot — leketz hammizbeach. motar teruma — lichle sharet.

Rabbi akiva omer: motar teruma — leketz hammizbeach, motar nesachim — lichle sharet. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: motar nesachim leketz hammizbeach, motar teruma lichle sharet. veze vaze, lo hayu modim beferot.
"Perot" may hi? — detanya: motar teruma ma hayu osin bah? lokchin perot bezol umochrin otam beyoker, vehassachar — mekayyetzin bo et hammizbeach. vezo hi sheshshaninu: motar perot leketz hammizbeach.

May "ze vaze lo hayu modin beferot"? ditnan: motar sheyare lishka ma hayu osin bahen? lokchin bahen yenot shemanim uselatot, vehassachar — lahekdesh, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en mistakkerin beshel hekdesh, af lo beshel aniyyim.
Beshel hekdesh may tama la — en aniyyut bimkom ashirut. beshel aniyyim may tama la — dilma mitreme lehu anya velekka lemitteva leh.
Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam. ittemar, rav amar:
